COMPARE AND CONTRAST — HEALTH AND SAFETY IN THE WORKSHOP
====

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
----
• Say what compare and contrast — health and safety in the workshop means in plain words.
• Give one Kenyan example linked to Health and Safety in the Workshop.
• Correct one common mistake about this page.

INTRODUCTION
----
At a playground in Eldoret, compare and contrast — health and safety in the workshop is not just a heading — it is a skill you use when you explain Health and Safety in the Workshop with evidence. In plain words: explain safety precautions to be observed in a workshop,.

MAIN NOTES
----
• Compare and Contrast — Health and Safety in the Workshop helps you understand Health and Safety in the Workshop in WOODWORK.
• Meaning in plain words: Understand and practise: explain safety precautions to be observed in a workshop,.
• Use accurate subject words — do not replace them with vague slogans.
• Link the idea to a real situation at a playground in Eldoret so you can remember it in an exam.
• Respect safety, honesty, and other people when you practise Health and Safety in the Workshop.
• If two ideas look similar, compare them: say what is the same and what is different.

WORKED EXAMPLE
----
Worked situation at a playground in Eldoret: a learner investigates compare and contrast — health and safety in the workshop within Health and Safety in the Workshop.
First, state the idea clearly: Understand and practise: explain safety precautions to be observed in a workshop,
Next, apply it to one object or action at a playground in Eldoret and name what changes or what stays the same.
Finally, write one accurate conclusion sentence a teacher could tick — using the correct subject words for WOODWORK.

IN EVERYDAY LIFE
----
At a playground in Eldoret, practise compare and contrast — health and safety in the workshop during ordinary routines at home or school. Ask: what did I observe, which word or formula fits, and how do I check I am right? Use the diagram or working on this page as your model. Safety and respect come first.

• Compare and Contrast — Health and Safety in the Workshop helps you understand Health and Safety in the Workshop in WOODWORK.
• Meaning in plain words: Understand and practise: explain safety precautions to be observed in a workshop,.
• Use accurate subject words — do not replace them with vague slogans.
• Link the idea to a real situation at a playground in Eldoret so you can remember it in an exam.

2. Describe a situation at a playground in Eldoret that shows Health and Safety in the Workshop, using ideas from this page.
3. A learner makes a mistake about compare and contrast — health and safety in the workshop. State the wrong idea, correct it, and justify your correction.
